a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator up to 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve only has 4, so only one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a fairer idea, say so and I'll consider it, and if the episode continues I'll operate with you afterward to help you reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting nearly fatal. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen mine yet, and I'm sorry this departs from our agreement. If the episode continues I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
